summary: Fixes Notification.archive so a value that casts to nil (e.g. an empty string from POST /notifications/archive_selected or the API's value param) archives the notifications instead of writing archived = NULL via update_all (which skipped the true/false validation and left notifications in neither the inbox nor the archive).

statements.why: notification.rb:80-81 changes behaviour of the archive action used by notifications_controller.rb:116 and api/notifications_controller.rb:217: an empty value now archives instead of saving NULL.

misses.what: Bug fix to archiving: a request with an empty 'value' used to set archived to NULL (bypassing validation), so notifications vanished from both Inbox and Archive; now they are archived.
Notifications already stuck with archived = NULL from the old bug are not repaired by this commit.
